comment: GENERATED by tools/mech_intake.mjs from the mechs/ export — do not hand-edit, EXCEPT characters.<id>.toon, which is art direction (tools/derive_cel_from_canonical.mjs, or the toon workbench) and is carried across a regeneration. clips.<state>.glb names the mech's OWN exported animation driving that state; clips.<state>.freeze holds it at that time in seconds (resolveClip in render3d/src/loader.js).
